# Slice

> > Slice connects customers with independent local pizzerias through mobile ordering, delivery, and pizzeria management tools.

Slice (operated by Slice Solutions, Inc. and MyPizza Technologies, Inc.) provides a platform for ordering from local pizza shops via iOS and Android apps, featuring the Slice Rewards loyalty program with Pizza Points. The service also offers management solutions for pizzeria owners to run their businesses.

## Key Topics

- Slice platform and mobile apps
- Local pizzeria ordering and delivery
- Slice Rewards and Pizza Points loyalty program
- iOS and Android applications
- Pizzeria management tools
- MyPizza Technologies Inc.
- Slice Solutions Inc.
- Privacy policy and CCPA compliance
- Account management
- Payment methods
- Customer support
- Slice SMS notifications
- Slice Family Membership
- Independent pizza shops

## Core Platform

- [Get The Slice App - Order from Your Favorite Local Pizzeria on Android & iOS](https://slicelife.com/pages/apps): Mobile app download page for iOS/Android with Pizza Points loyalty rewards
- [Slice | Management And Support For Pizzerias](https://slicelife.com/owners): Pizzeria management services and tools for independent pizza shop owners
